description: List tokens on QIE mainnet (chain 1990) or testnet (chain 1983) from the configured token list or the network explorer. An optional query matches symbol or name. yourname.qie is a QIE ID example, not a token query. Results are capped at 50 and do not include prices. This tool does not give price, APY, returns, yield, or investment advice and will decline such questions.

limit.description: Maximum tokens to return. Default 20, maximum 50.

network.description: Pinned network. mainnet is chain 1990 and testnet is chain 1983. Defaults to mainnet. A raw chain ID or RPC URL is not accepted.

query.description: Optional symbol or name fragment. Not a price or yield question.

name: qie_list_tokens
title: List tokens
